name: player_reset_mouse_control_state_and_recenter_cursor
description: Player::ResetMouseControlStateAndRecenterCursor clears mouse-driven third-person camera offsets and delegates to zInput::Mouse_RecenterCursor.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x426330 validates ECX as zUtil_SaveGameState*, loading saveState->playerState at +0x04, clearing PlayerState::thirdPersonYawOffset at +0x4fc and PlayerState::cameraElevationOffset at +0x508, and tail-jumping to zInput::Mouse_RecenterCursor.
The native smoke verifies both player-state offset clears, preservation of a neighboring camera field, and the delegated full mouse recenter side effects on the cached zInput mouse state.
